Meridian Constructors & Co. 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Madhya Pradesh · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/47/2020/127 
 Dated: 31/03/2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Extradosed Bridge - Madhya Pradesh Pkg-127" (large bridges),
 awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has
 been completed in all respects on 13/11/2020 at a gross executed value of INR 129.88 Cr (Rupees 129.88
 
 Crore Only). 
 The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and contract
 
 conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried out by the
 undersigned. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Suresh Desai. This certificate is issued for record and for
 submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Meridian Constructors & Co. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-CC-127 Page 1 of 1
